newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Tuan Sing buys 70 pct stake in jv deal.
newsitem.headline: Tuan Sing buys 70 pct stake in jv deal.

text.p: Diversified group Tuan Sing Holdings Ltd said on Tuesday it has signed an agreement to take a 70 percent stake in Chuan Seng International Holdings (S) Pte Ltd (CSI).
The company said in a statement the 30 percent balance would be held by Raymond Chew Chuan Seng and his wife.
CSI would be used as a joint venture vehicle to redevelop Adam Garden and Shelford Apartments, two prime, free-hold residential properties into a condominium project for sale.
The total investment amount will be up to Singapore $35.9 million, with Tuan Sing contributing up to S$26.5 million through is wholly-owned subsidiary Silveridge Investments Pte Ltd.

The subscription price for CSI shares will be based on the net tangible assets per share of CSI as at completion and the investment amount by Silveridge is expected to be satisified from internal resources and/or bank borrowings.
CSI is a Singapore-incorporated company with authorised capital of S$3 million, divided into three million ordinary shares of S$1.00 each, of which about 1.9 million are held by the Chews.
